Aatrox.watch: Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade deals his main damage and can knock you up, so when you see him cast it, move beyond the blade’s edge or close in. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains hits you, leave the area immediately and cleanse the slow with Garen Q Decisive Strike. When Aatrox R World Ender is active, his attack damage and healing increase, so create distance and wait out its duration.
Aatrox.build: Build armor first to reduce the physical damage from Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains. If Aatrox’s healing makes duels drag on, buy Executioner's Calling early to apply Grievous Wounds, then build Mortal Reminder sooner. Add armor penetration because Aatrox’s high armor reduces Garen’s mainly physical damage.
Aatrox.fight: Early on, look for an opening right after Aatrox uses his empowered Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance attack on a minion. Dodge the edge of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade, then close the distance right after he uses Aatrox E Umbral Dash. Activate Garen W Courage as Aatrox’s attack arrives to absorb it with the shield and tenacity.
Aatrox.laning: Avoid giving Aatrox an early kill, collect CS and last hits, and let the wave push toward you. When Aatrox steps forward to last-hit, trade briefly. If Garen E Judgment pushes the wave, retreat into a brush or behind your turret to trigger healing from Garen P Perseverance. Keep a ward ready so you are not pressured while the wave is pushed out.
Aatrox.combo: When approaching, use Garen Q Decisive Strike, then land an empowered attack to silence him, then cast Garen E Judgment. If Aatrox is already on you, start with Garen E Judgment and save Garen Q Decisive Strike; activate it to counterattack, then land the empowered attack after the spin ends. To finish him, lower his health with Garen E Judgment before using Garen R Demacian Justice. If he looks ready to escape, end the spin early and use it immediately.
Aatrox.phase: Early on, it is important to survive without giving Aatrox a kill. Garen gets stronger as he stacks and the matchup improves; in the mid game, turn your lane advantage into a lead through split pushing when Garen Q Decisive Strike and Garen R Demacian Justice reach their peak. In the late game, Garen E Judgment may not be enough on its own, so use Garen R Demacian Justice on low-health opponents.
Aatrox.teamfight: When your team starts a fight, activate Garen W Courage as the enemy attack hits and engage. Use Garen E Judgment to reduce armor and hold the frontline, then cast Garen R Demacian Justice on a low-health opponent. If you cannot engage head-on, look for an angle from the flank or outside vision; if there is no teamfight angle, pin down an enemy on the side lane.

Akali.watch: Prioritize dodging the first projectile of Akali E Shuriken Flip. Once marked, the second dash will follow you even if you run, so if you are hit, time Garen W Courage for when Akali goes in. You cannot walk away from the first dash of Akali R Perfect Execution, and its second hit grows stronger based on your missing health.
Akali.build: Get magic resistance and tenacity early with Mercury's Treads to prepare for Akali’s main damage. Continue building magic resistance and health so you do not easily enter Akali R Perfect Execution’s execute range.
Akali.fight: If Akali Q Five Point Strike slows you, cleanse it with Garen Q Decisive Strike, close in to silence her, then cast Garen E Judgment. Use Garen W Courage for its shield as Akali’s attack comes in.
Akali.laning: Let the wave push toward you and keep a ward ready, then trade when Akali goes to last-hit a minion. After the trade, back off briefly to recover health with Garen P Perseverance, and collect last hits to stack the armor and magic resistance from Garen W Courage.
Akali.combo: When you can get close, attack in this order: Garen Q Decisive Strike, an empowered attack to silence her, then Garen E Judgment. If Akali is already on you, start with Garen E Judgment and activate Garen Q Decisive Strike during the spin, saving the silencing attack for your counterattack. To finish her, lower her health with Garen E Judgment, then use Garen R Demacian Justice; if she looks ready to escape, end the spin early and cast it.
Akali.escape: Do not engage just because Akali W Twilight Shroud is down; check whether Akali E Shuriken Flip and R Perfect Execution are also available. The best opening is especially before Akali R Perfect Execution comes back. If Akali Q Five Point Strike slows you, cleanse it with Garen Q Decisive Strike before closing in.
Akali.phase: Garen is strongest in the mid game, so turn your lane advantage into split-pushing gains. In the late game, Garen E Judgment may not deal enough damage on its own, so focus on finding chances to use Garen R Demacian Justice on low-health opponents.
Akali.teamfight: When your team starts a fight, activate Garen W Courage as the enemy attack hits and go in. Use Garen E Judgment to reduce armor and hold the frontline, then cast Garen R Demacian Justice on a low-health opponent. If you cannot engage head-on, look for an angle from the flank or outside vision; if there is no teamfight angle, split push on the side lane.

Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again when recalled, and that damage increases the more health Garen has lost. If you are cursed, move off the line connecting you to Aurora; if you are below half health, retreat before it is recalled. After Aurora R Between Worlds appears, leaving the area slows you, so decide whether to leave before it forms or fight inside it.
Aurora.build: If Aurora’s magic damage is threatening, get magic resistance and tenacity with Mercury's Treads. Consider Boots of Swiftness if slows make it hard to get close. If healing from Aurora P Spirit Abjuration lets her survive trades, get Executioner's Calling early to apply Grievous Wounds.
Aurora.fight: Trade briefly when Aurora steps forward to last-hit a minion. Answer the slow from Aurora E The Weirding with Garen Q Decisive Strike, and activate Garen W Courage as her attack comes in to gain its shield and tenacity. Do not chase too far while Aurora still has a mobility ability available.
Aurora.laning: Let the wave push toward you to draw Aurora forward, and keep a ward ready against ganks. After trading, retreat into a brush or behind your turret to trigger healing from Garen P Perseverance. Collect last hits as well to build stacks toward the armor and magic resistance growth from Garen W Courage.
Aurora.combo: When you can approach, use Garen Q Decisive Strike, then an empowered attack to silence her, then cast Garen E Judgment. If she is already on you, start with Garen E Judgment and save Garen Q Decisive Strike to use as she counterattacks. Once you have lowered her health enough to kill her, end Garen E Judgment or cut it short, then finish with Garen R Demacian Justice.
Aurora.escape: You have a chance to engage again after both Aurora W Across the Veil and Aurora E The Weirding are down.
Aurora.phase: Early on, endure Aurora’s poke and manage your health with Garen P Perseverance. In the late game, Garen E Judgment may not be enough to kill an opponent, so look for chances to use Garen R Demacian Justice on low-health targets.
Aurora.teamfight: When your team starts a fight, engage from the flank or outside vision, and activate Garen W Courage as Aurora’s attack comes in. Use Garen E Judgment to reduce armor and hold your ground, then cast Garen R Demacian Justice on a low-health opponent. If Aurora used her leap to engage and failed to help secure a takedown, that is a chance to catch her; if there is no teamfight angle, pin down an enemy on the side lane.

Camille.watch: Camille E Hookshot uses a wall to dash in from range and stun you, so stand away from walls. When Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum engages, do not use your defensive ability; wait out the time you are trapped, then counterattack.
Camille.build: If Camille W Tactical Sweep’s healing makes trades difficult, buy Executioner's Calling early and build Mortal Reminder sooner. Build armor first against Camille’s main physical damage, but armor cannot reduce the true damage from Camille Q Precision Protocol. Stacking only health also increases the damage from Camille W Tactical Sweep.
Camille.fight: Avoid trading right after Camille P Adaptive Defenses activates its shield; engage after it wears off. Activate Garen W Courage as Camille E Hookshot’s stun hits, and if Camille W Tactical Sweep slows you, cleanse it with Garen Q Decisive Strike.
Camille.laning: Stand away from walls and among your minions, and let the wave push toward you so you can trade when Camille steps up to last-hit. If Garen E Judgment pushes the wave, retreat into a brush to heal with Garen P Perseverance. Collect last hits to build armor and magic resistance stacks from Garen W Courage, and ward for when the wave pushes out.
Camille.combo: After Camille P Adaptive Defenses’ shield wears off, use Garen Q Decisive Strike, then an empowered attack to silence her, then Garen E Judgment. If Camille is already on you, start Garen E Judgment and save Garen Q Decisive Strike so your first attack silences her after the spin ends. To finish her, lower her health with Garen E Judgment before using Garen R Demacian Justice; if she looks ready to escape, end Garen E Judgment early.
Camille.escape: Once Camille E Hookshot is down, you have a chance to engage, but if Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum is still available, she can use that mobility ability to escape.
Camille.phase: Camille is at her weakest early, before her first core item, but Garen can survive the early game and build stacks; the longer the game goes, the more favorable the matchup becomes. Garen peaks in the mid game, so turn your lane advantage into a lead through split pushing then. In the late game, Garen E Judgment may not be enough on its own, so look for chances to use Garen R Demacian Justice on low-health opponents.
Camille.teamfight: When your team starts a fight, engage while timing Garen W Courage to incoming abilities such as Camille E Hookshot. Use Garen E Judgment to reduce the enemy’s armor and hold your ground, then cast Garen R Demacian Justice on a low-health opponent. If there is no engage angle, hold an opponent on the side lane while sustaining with Garen P Perseverance.

Chogath.watch: Cho'Gath Q Rupture knocks you up and slows you after a warning appears beneath you, so move sideways as soon as you see it. If Cho'Gath W Feral Scream silences you, it will be hard to dodge the follow-up Cho'Gath Q Rupture, so avoid standing in front of him. If you are below half health, keep your distance to avoid the true damage from Cho'Gath R Feast.
Chogath.build: If Cho'Gath P Carnivore's healing puts you behind in trades, buy Executioner's Calling early and work toward Mortal Reminder. Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes scales with his maximum health, so avoid relying on health stacking alone.
Chogath.fight: Look for an opening after dodging the warning for Cho'Gath Q Rupture or right after he uses it on the wave. If Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes slows you, cleanse it with Garen Q Decisive Strike and close in. Use Garen W Courage as Cho'Gath Q Rupture or W Feral Scream comes in, and stay closer to Cho'Gath than to the minions while spinning with Garen E Judgment.
Chogath.laning: Keep the wave near your side to reduce situations where Garen has to walk far out without a mobility spell and gets pressured, and keep a ward handy. Trade when Cho'Gath steps forward to last-hit, but don't stand in a line behind minions that Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes passes through. If Garen E Judgment pushes the wave, briefly back off to trigger healing from Garen P Perseverance.
Chogath.combo: After dodging Cho'Gath Q Rupture and W Feral Scream, close in with Garen Q Decisive Strike, silence him with the empowered attack, then spin with Garen E Judgment. If you are already on him, use Garen E Judgment first and save Garen Q Decisive Strike; when Cho'Gath tries to retaliate, silence him with your first attack after the spin. To finish, lower his health with Garen E Judgment, then use Garen R Demacian Justice. If Cho'Gath is about to escape, end Garen E Judgment early and use your ultimate.
Chogath.escape: Go in when Cho'Gath Q Rupture has been used on the wave or missed, and Cho'Gath W Feral Scream is also on cooldown. Since Cho'Gath has no mobility spell, you can stick to him and trade during this window. If the slow is still on you, cleanse it with Garen Q Decisive Strike before closing in.
Chogath.phase: Early on, look for close-range trades using Garen's base health and Garen P Perseverance. Mid game is when Garen is strongest, so turn your lane advantage into split-push gains. Late game, Cho'Gath's Cho'Gath R Feast stacks make him durable, and Garen E Judgment alone may not be enough; focus on using Garen R Demacian Justice on weakened enemies.
Chogath.teamfight: When your team engages first, activate Garen W Courage as Cho'Gath's crowd control lands and go in. Shred armor with Garen E Judgment while holding the front line, then use Garen R Demacian Justice on a weakened enemy. If a frontal engage is difficult, look for an angle from the flank or out of vision; if there is no opening, split-push on the side lane.

Fiora.watch: Fiora W Riposte negates attacks and counters, so don't rush to use Garen Q Decisive Strike's empowered attack or Garen R Demacian Justice while it is available. Move to the side when using key abilities to avoid Riposte, and if Fiora R Grand Challenge targets you, stand against a wall to block one side's vital.
Fiora.build: Build armor early against the physical damage from Fiora Q Lunge and Fiora E Bladework. If her healing makes trades difficult, buy Executioner's Calling early and work toward Mortal Reminder. Armor does not reduce the true damage from vitals, and she deals damage based on your maximum health, so don't rely on stacking health alone.
Fiora.fight: Stand opposite the vital shown on your body and briefly retaliate when Fiora moves in to target it. Close the gap just after Fiora Q Lunge, and land your major attacks after Fiora W Riposte is down. Once the trade is over, don't overchase.
Fiora.laning: Keep the wave near your side and keep a ward handy; take short trades when Fiora steps up to last-hit. Back off afterward to recover health with Garen P Perseverance. Also last-hit minions to build stacks for Garen W Courage.
Fiora.combo: If Fiora W Riposte is down and you can close in, attack in this order: Garen Q Decisive Strike → empowered attack to silence → Garen E Judgment. If Fiora is already on you, start with Garen E Judgment and save Garen Q Decisive Strike until she retaliates, then land the empowered attack after the spin. To finish, lower her health before using Garen R Demacian Justice; if Fiora is about to escape, end Garen E Judgment early and use your ultimate immediately.
Fiora.phase: Early on, keep the wave near your side, take short trades, and sustain with Garen P Perseverance. Garen peaks in mid game, so turn your lane advantage into gains through split-pushing then.
Fiora.teamfight: When your team engages first, activate Garen W Courage as incoming attacks land, then shred armor with Garen E Judgment and use Garen R Demacian Justice on a weakened enemy. If Fiora R Grand Challenge targets you, stand against a wall so she cannot reach all four vitals.

Darius.watch: If Darius E Apprehend pulls you in, he can follow with an attack, Darius W Crippling Strike, and Darius Q Decimate, so wait outside its range and approach after E misses. When you see Darius Q Decimate, move outside the blade's edge or hug him to reduce its damage and healing. If stacks of Darius P Hemorrhage build up, create distance to break off the fight; when you have stacks and low health, get completely out of range of Darius R Noxian Guillotine.
Darius.build: Build armor early against the physical damage from Darius P Hemorrhage, Darius Q Decimate, and Darius W Crippling Strike. Also build health to account for the armor penetration on Darius E Apprehend and the true damage from Darius R Noxian Guillotine. If the healing from Darius Q Decimate is a problem, buy Executioner's Calling early or work toward Mortal Reminder.
Darius.fight: Take short trades when Darius E Apprehend misses or is on cooldown. If Darius W Crippling Strike slows you, cleanse it with Garen Q Decisive Strike; when Darius E Apprehend pulls you in, time Garen W Courage to gain its shield and tenacity. Don't let Darius build Darius P Hemorrhage stacks in a long fight, and look for an opening just after he uses Darius Q Decimate to clear minions.
Darius.laning: Keep the wave near your side and keep a ward handy to avoid early skirmishes and enemy jungle ganks. Trade briefly when Darius steps up to last-hit or just after he uses Darius Q Decimate to clear minions, provided Darius E Apprehend is down. Back off afterward to recover health with Garen P Perseverance, and last-hit minions to build the armor from Garen W Courage.
Darius.combo: If Darius E Apprehend is down and you need to close the gap, take a short trade with Garen Q Decisive Strike → empowered attack to silence → Garen E Judgment. If you are already on him, start with Garen E Judgment and save Garen Q Decisive Strike until you can cleanse the slow from Darius W Crippling Strike; land the empowered attack after the spin. When you can secure the kill, lower his health with Garen E Judgment, then finish with Garen R Demacian Justice.
Darius.escape: The window to engage is when Darius E Apprehend misses or is on cooldown.
Darius.phase: Early on, watch out for Darius skirmishes and dives; survive with short trades and healing from Garen P Perseverance. Mid game is when Garen is strongest, so gain a lane advantage and turn it into split-push gains. Late game, enemies become more durable, making kills with Garen E Judgment alone difficult; look for chances to use Garen R Demacian Justice on weakened enemies.
Darius.teamfight: When your team engages, activate Garen W Courage as the enemy uses abilities and go in to shred armor with Garen E Judgment. Back off so you don't stay at low health with Darius P Hemorrhage stacks and let Darius secure a kill with Darius R Noxian Guillotine and reset its cooldown. Engage from the flank or out of vision; if there is no opening, split-push to keep an enemy occupied in the side lane.

DrMundo.watch: Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw only hits the first target and deals more damage the higher your current health is, so dodge it with a minion between you. If it hits and slows you, cleanse the slow with Garen Q Decisive Strike. Use Garen W Courage to absorb damage as Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma's empowered attack or Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper comes in. While Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active, account for its healing and movement speed and don't force a kill.
DrMundo.build: Build armor early against the physical damage from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. If Dr. Mundo's healing makes the duel drag on, buy Executioner's Calling early or work toward Mortal Reminder. If the slow from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw makes it hard to stick to him, buy Boots of Swiftness.
DrMundo.fight: Dodge Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw from behind minions and trade when he steps forward to last-hit. If it hits, cleanse the slow with Garen Q Decisive Strike, close in, then land the silencing attack and Garen E Judgment. Look for a chance to kill after Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage ends.
DrMundo.laning: Keep the wave near your side and keep a ward handy; fight when Dr. Mundo steps forward. After trading, briefly back off to recover health with Garen P Perseverance, and last-hit minions to build the armor and magic resistance from Garen W Courage. If Dr. Mundo drops his canister, step on it while backing away to deny its healing and passive cooldown reduction.
DrMundo.combo: After Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw slows you, cleanse it with Garen Q Decisive Strike, close in, silence him with the empowered attack, then spin with Garen E Judgment. If Dr. Mundo is already on you, start with Garen E Judgment and save Garen Q Decisive Strike so you can land the empowered attack when he retaliates. To kill him, lower his health with E, then use Garen R Demacian Justice; if he shows signs of escaping, end E early and use R.
DrMundo.escape: Dr. Mundo has no ability to create distance, so engage after dodging Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw or when you can cleanse its slow with Garen Q Decisive Strike. You can also look for a kill while Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is on cooldown.
DrMundo.phase: Early on, keep the wave near your side and hold on while dodging Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw. Garen grows stronger as he builds up and is strongest in mid game, so turn your lane advantage into gains through split-pushing then. Late game, Garen E Judgment alone may not be enough; look for an opening to use Garen R Demacian Justice on a weakened enemy.
DrMundo.teamfight: When your team engages, activate Garen W Courage as the enemy attacks and go in to shred armor with Garen E Judgment. Use Garen R Demacian Justice on weakened enemies, and look for an angle from the flank or out of vision if a frontal engage is difficult. If there is no teamfight opening or Dr. Mundo is hard to kill because of Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage, apply pressure in the side lane.

Gangplank.build: Build armor early to withstand Gangplank Q Parrrley poke and Gangplank E Powder Keg damage. If the healing from Gangplank W Remove Scurvy makes trades difficult, buy Executioner’s Calling early to apply Grievous Wounds. If you’re repeatedly held back by slows, choose Boots of Swiftness over Berserker’s Greaves.
Gangplank.fight: Trade when Gangplank E Powder Keg has just been placed and isn’t primed yet. If slowed, cleanse it with Garen Q Decisive Strike, then use the movement speed boost to close in. Activate Garen W Courage as the enemy attack comes in. Delay the fight if there’s a primed E Powder Keg nearby.
Gangplank.laning: Early on, let the wave push toward you, keep wards up, and withstand Gangplank Q Parrrley poke. Look to trade when Gangplank steps forward to last-hit or has just placed Gangplank E Powder Keg. After trading, back off briefly to heal with Garen P Perseverance, and secure last hits to build Garen W Courage’s armor growth.
Gangplank.combo: When you can close the gap, attack in this order: Garen Q Decisive Strike → empowered basic attack for the silence → Garen E Judgment. If you’re already on top of him, start with Garen E Judgment and hold Garen Q Decisive Strike until the spin ends, then silence him with the empowered basic attack. To finish him, lower his health with Garen E Judgment before using Garen R Demacian Justice. If he looks ready to flee, end Garen E Judgment early and use R immediately.
Gangplank.escape: The window to engage is right after Gangplank E Powder Keg is placed, before it becomes primed. If its slow hits you, cleanse it with Garen Q Decisive Strike and close in. Don’t engage if a nearby barrel is already primed. Gangplank has no ability to create distance on his own, so pressure him as soon as you have an opening to get on top of him.
Gangplank.teamfight: When your team engages first, enter the fight with Garen W Courage timed to the incoming enemy attack. Hold your ground while Garen E Judgment shreds enemy armor, then use Garen R Demacian Justice on a low-health enemy. If a frontal engage is difficult, look for an angle from the flank or out of vision. If there’s no opening for a team fight, split push to keep an enemy occupied in a side lane.

Gnar.watch: Mini Gnar’s Gnar Q Boomerang Throw can hit both on the way out and on its return, so move out of its path. Watch whether Gnar E Hop / Crunch is available before engaging, since it can create distance. Mega Gnar’s Gnar R GNAR! stuns you if it knocks you into a wall, so don’t stand with your back to one. Activate Garen W Courage just before it hits.
Gnar.build: Build armor first to withstand damage from Gnar Q, E, and R. Gnar W Hyper / Wallop deals magic damage based on your maximum health, so don’t rely on stacking health alone. If the enemy team has many slows, choose Boots of Swiftness over Berserker’s Greaves.
Gnar.fight: Watch Gnar’s rage bar and look for an opening just after he changes from Mega Gnar back to Mini Gnar. If Gnar E Hop / Crunch is also on cooldown, close the gap with Garen Q Decisive Strike, apply the silence, and trade with Garen E Judgment. Avoid fighting head-on just after Gnar transforms into Mega Gnar, and create distance.
Gnar.combo: Right after Gnar slows you, cleanse it with Garen Q Decisive Strike, close in, silence him with the empowered basic attack, then use Garen E Judgment. If Gnar is already on top of you, start with Garen E Judgment and hold Garen Q Decisive Strike until the spin ends, then silence him with your first basic attack. To finish him, lower his health with Garen E Judgment before using Garen R Demacian Justice. If Gnar tries to escape, end E early and use R.
Gnar.escape: The window to close the gap is right after Gnar E Hop / Crunch is used. Gnar can’t transform again for a while just after changing from Mega Gnar back to Mini Gnar, so look to engage then. If slowed, cleanse it with Garen Q Decisive Strike. Activate Garen W Courage as Gnar’s crowd control hits.
Gnar.phase: Early on, let the wave push toward you while withstanding Mini Gnar’s ranged poke. Mid game is Garen’s power peak, when Garen Q Decisive Strike and Garen R Demacian Justice become stronger, so build a lane advantage and secure it by split pushing. Comparing the two champions, Garen becomes more favored as the game goes on if he survives the early game, but Garen E Judgment may not be enough late game, so finish low-health enemies with R.
Gnar.teamfight: Avoid standing with your back to a wall or in narrow terrain so Gnar R GNAR! can’t knock you into a wall. When your team engages first, activate Garen W Courage as Gnar’s crowd control hits, then enter from the flank or out of vision and shred armor with Garen E Judgment. Use Garen R Demacian Justice on a low-health enemy. If there’s no opening to engage, split push in a side lane.

Gwen.watch: The center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! deals true damage, so move sideways during the cast to avoid it. If slowed by Gwen R Needlework, cleanse it with Garen Q Decisive Strike and manage your distance. While Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, don’t cast targeted abilities from outside the mist; enter it or wait for it to end.
Gwen.build: Build magic resistance first to withstand Gwen’s magic damage, and also build armor against her basic attack damage. If her healing makes trades difficult, prioritize Mortal Reminder or buy Executioner’s Calling early. Choose Boots of Swiftness if slows are the main threat, or Mercury’s Treads if magic damage and crowd control are more threatening.
Gwen.fight: Trade before Gwen builds stacks for Q Snip Snip! or right after she uses E Skip 'n Slash. Dodge the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! by moving sideways, and activate Garen W Courage as her attack comes in. If Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, don’t cast Garen R Demacian Justice from outside the mist.
Gwen.laning: Let the wave push toward you and keep wards up. Trade briefly when Gwen steps forward to last-hit. Don’t chase for long among many minions, since Gwen E Skip 'n Slash can keep getting her out of danger there. After trading, retreat into a brush or behind your turret to heal with Garen P Perseverance, and secure last hits to build the armor and magic resistance from Garen W Courage.
Gwen.combo: When you can get on top of her, close in with Garen Q Decisive Strike, silence her with the empowered basic attack, then spin with Garen E Judgment. If Gwen is already on top of you, start with Garen E Judgment and hold Garen Q Decisive Strike until the spin ends, then silence her with a basic attack. To finish her, lower her health with Garen E Judgment before using Garen R Demacian Justice. If she tries to escape, end the spin early and use R immediately.
Gwen.escape: Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is her only mobility tool, so right after she uses it is Garen’s chance to close the gap. If slowed by Gwen R Needlework, cleanse the slow with Garen Q Decisive Strike, then close in or escape.
Gwen.phase: Early on, look to trade before Gwen builds stacks for Q Snip Snip!, but rely on Garen P Perseverance to recover after unfavorable trades. Mid game is when Garen is strong, so build a lane advantage and secure it by split pushing. In the late game, enemies become tankier, making it harder to finish them with Garen E Judgment alone, so look for a chance to use Garen R Demacian Justice on enemies whose health you’ve lowered.
Gwen.teamfight: When your team engages, activate Garen W Courage as the enemy attack comes in, then enter and shred armor with Garen E Judgment. Enter from the flank or out of vision rather than walking in head-on, and finish low-health enemies with Garen R Demacian Justice. If there’s no opening to engage, switch to split pushing and use Garen P Perseverance to sustain in the side lane.

Illaoi.watch: Illaoi E Test of Spirit slows and marks you, so last-hit from outside its range and dodge the cast. If slowed, cleanse it with Garen Q Decisive Strike. While Illaoi R Leap of Faith is active, don’t fight near the tentacles; spread out and wait for the burst to end.
Illaoi.build: If healing from Illaoi P Prophet of an Elder God is a problem, buy Executioner’s Calling early to apply Grievous Wounds. Illaoi’s main damage is physical, and W Harsh Lesson deals damage based on your maximum health, so build armor first instead of stacking health alone. If there are many slows, choose Boots of Swiftness over Berserker’s Greaves.
Illaoi.fight: Dodge Illaoi E Test of Spirit, then close the gap right after she uses Illaoi W Harsh Lesson, her only mobility tool. Use the movement speed boost from Garen Q Decisive Strike to get on top of her, and activate Garen W Courage as her attack comes in. Even if Illaoi is low on health, she can heal by hitting you with tentacles, so don’t force a dive where tentacles are set up.
Illaoi.laning: Don’t push the wave; let it come toward you, and keep your distance from walls where Illaoi places tentacles. Last-hit from outside Illaoi E Test of Spirit range, and look to trade when she steps forward to farm. After trading, retreat into a brush or behind your turret to heal with Garen P Perseverance, and secure last hits to build Garen W Courage’s armor growth stacks.
Illaoi.combo: If you can close the gap, deal damage in this order: Garen Q Decisive Strike → empowered basic attack for the silence → Garen E Judgment. If you’re already on top of her, start with Garen E Judgment and hold Garen Q Decisive Strike until she tries to retaliate. To finish her, lower her health with Garen E Judgment before using Garen R Demacian Justice. If she tries to escape, end E early and use R.
Illaoi.escape: Dodge Illaoi E Test of Spirit. The window to engage is right after Illaoi W Harsh Lesson is used. If you can fight even after your spirit is pulled, fight back. If you can’t, break the tether and dodge the first tentacle. Once you’re marked, wait beside that tentacle until the mark expires.
Illaoi.teamfight: Don’t group up in front of Illaoi. When she uses Illaoi R Leap of Faith, spread out to weather its brief burst. Destroy tentacles if you can; otherwise, draw Illaoi into open ground away from walls. When your team engages, activate Garen W Courage as the attack comes in and enter the fight. Shred armor with Garen E Judgment, then use Garen R Demacian Justice on a low-health enemy.

Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain through low-health minions to close the gap, so keep your distance when minions are about to die. Use Garen W Courage as Irelia E Flawless Duet flies toward you to absorb the stun. If you’re trapped inside Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge, wait until the blades disappear. If you’re slowed, cleanse it with Garen Q Decisive Strike.
Irelia.build: Build armor first to withstand the physical damage from Irelia Q Bladesurge and Irelia W Defiant Dance. If Irelia’s basic attacks and attack speed are a problem, consider an option that reduces attack speed. If the healing from Irelia Q Bladesurge disrupts trades, buy Executioner’s Calling early or prioritize Mortal Reminder.
Irelia.fight: Close the gap when Irelia steps up to last-hit minions or just after she uses Irelia Q Bladesurge. When Irelia E Flawless Duet flies toward you, time Garen W Courage to absorb it, then silence her with Garen Q Decisive Strike and deal damage with Garen E Judgment. Position yourself so only Irelia is inside Garen E Judgment’s spin.
Irelia.laning: Afterward, pull the wave toward your side and avoid leaving low-health minions between you and Irelia that could give her a path in with Irelia Q Bladesurge. After a trade, briefly back off to recover health with Garen P Perseverance. If you push the wave, ward against ganks.
Irelia.combo: When engaging first, use Garen Q Decisive Strike → empowered basic attack to silence → Garen E Judgment. If Irelia has already engaged, start with Garen E Judgment and save Garen Q Decisive Strike, then silence her with the empowered basic attack after the spin. To execute, reduce her health with Garen E Judgment before using Garen R Demacian Justice. If Irelia tries to escape, end Garen E Judgment early and use R immediately.
Irelia.escape: Just after Irelia uses Irelia Q Bladesurge is your chance to close in. If Irelia E Flawless Duet is on cooldown, engage with Garen Q Decisive Strike while the threat of being stunned is lower. If you’re slowed by Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge, cleanse it with Garen Q Decisive Strike and close in.
Irelia.phase: Garen peaks in mid game, so build on your lane advantage and split-push. If you survive the early game, you become more favored against Irelia as the game goes on, but Garen E Judgment alone may not be enough late game, so finish off low-health opponents with Garen R Demacian Justice.
Irelia.teamfight: Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge and Irelia E Flawless Duet have a big impact in team fights, so focus Irelia first. When your team engages, time Garen W Courage with the enemy’s abilities, then go in and shred armor with Garen E Judgment before using Garen R Demacian Justice on a low-health Irelia. If there’s no opening to engage, hold an opponent on the side lane while sustaining with Garen P Perseverance.

Jayce.watch: When you see Jayce E Acceleration Gate, Jayce Q Shock Blast may follow, so sidestep out of its line. When Jayce has his hammer out, watch for the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! and the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow. Activate Garen W Courage as the attack comes in to gain its shield and tenacity.
Jayce.build: Build magic resistance first against Jayce W Lightning Field / Hyper Charge and E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate. Magic resistance won’t block the physical damage from Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast, and Jayce R Mercury Cannon / Mercury Hammer reduces your resistances, so dodging his attacks is also important. If the enemy team has many slows, choose Boots of Swiftness instead of Berserker’s Greaves.
Jayce.fight: When Jayce has his cannon out, keep your distance and dodge his ranged poke. Close in just after the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! is used. If you’re slowed, cleanse it with Garen Q Decisive Strike as you engage. If you expect the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow, activate Garen W Courage as it hits.
Jayce.laning: Jayce is strong early, so don’t try to force a comeback; pull the wave toward your side and farm defensively. Move side to side while watching for Jayce Q Shock Blast in cannon form, and trade when Jayce steps up to last-hit minions. After the trade, briefly back off to recover health with Garen P Perseverance and keep wards ready.
Jayce.combo: After Jayce slows you, cleanse it with Garen Q Decisive Strike and engage. Silence him with the empowered basic attack, then use Garen E Judgment. If he’s already engaged, start with Garen E Judgment and save Garen Q Decisive Strike, then silence him with a basic attack after the spin. To finish him off, reduce his health with Garen E Judgment before using Garen R Demacian Justice. If Jayce looks ready to escape, end E early and use R.
Jayce.escape: Just after the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! is used is your chance to engage. If Jayce E Thundering Blow is also on cooldown, close in with the movement speed from Garen Q Decisive Strike and silence him. If you’re slowed by Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast, cleanse it with Garen Q Decisive Strike before engaging.
Jayce.phase: Jayce is strong early, so survive by farming defensively. Garen gets stronger as he builds up and peaks in mid game, so gain a lane advantage then and build on it with split-pushing. Late game, Garen E Judgment alone may not be enough to kill opponents, so look for a chance to use Garen R Demacian Justice on a low-health target.
Jayce.teamfight: Look for an opening to engage from the side or out of vision after the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! is used. When your team engages, activate Garen W Courage as the attack comes in, then shred armor with Garen E Judgment before using Garen R Demacian Justice on a low-health opponent. If there’s no opening to engage, use Garen P Perseverance to sustain on the side lane while holding an opponent there.

Jax.watch: Jax E Counter Strike negates basic attacks and on-hit effects, and stuns when recast, so don’t use the empowered basic attack from Garen Q Decisive Strike while it’s active; retreat outside the stun radius. If Jax engages with Jax Q Leap Strike and uses Counter Strike, time Garen W Courage for when the stun lands to gain its shield and tenacity.
Jax.build: Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so build both armor and magic resistance. If the magic damage and stun are a threat, switch to Mercury’s Treads for magic resistance and tenacity. For offensive items, prioritize attack speed and critical strike to strengthen Garen E Judgment.
Jax.fight: If Jax engages first, spin with Garen E Judgment and save Garen Q Decisive Strike, then use its empowered basic attack after Counter Strike ends.
Jax.laning: Pull the wave toward your side and keep wards ready. When Jax steps up to last-hit minions, watch whether he uses Counter Strike before trading. Pressure him with your jungler while Jax E Counter Strike is on cooldown, and back off after the trade to recover health with Garen P Perseverance. Keep last-hitting to build Garen W Courage’s armor and magic resistance growth stacks.
Jax.combo: After Jax E Counter Strike is used, close in with Garen Q Decisive Strike, silence him with the empowered basic attack, and spin with Garen E Judgment. If Jax has already engaged, start with Garen E Judgment, then use the empowered basic attack from Garen Q Decisive Strike after the spin. When he’s low enough to kill, reduce his health with Garen E Judgment, then finish him with Garen R Demacian Justice.
Jax.escape: Don’t engage just because Jax E Counter Strike is active. Move out of its stun radius and wait for it to expire. Just after Jax Q Leap Strike and E Counter Strike are used is your chance to close the gap with the movement speed from Garen Q Decisive Strike and fight.
Jax.phase: Garen peaks in mid game, so build on your lane advantage and split-push. Late game, Garen E Judgment alone may not be enough, so use Garen R Demacian Justice on low-health opponents.
Jax.teamfight: If Jax engages with E Counter Strike, don’t group up; avoid the area stun, then focus your crowd control with your team once the stun ends. When your team engages, time Garen W Courage with the stun, then go in and shred armor with Garen E Judgment while sustaining. Finish off low-health opponents with Garen R Demacian Justice. If there’s no opening to engage, split-push.

Kennen.watch: Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken only hits the first target, so stand behind minions. When Kennen P Mark of the Storm has two stacks, a third hit can stun you, so briefly move out of range. If you’re caught in Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom, time Garen W Courage to the moment the damage comes in.
Kennen.build: Prioritize Mercury’s Treads against Kennen’s magic damage and stun. Get tenacity first, then build magic resistance.
Kennen.fight: Close in and fight after Kennen E Lightning Rush is used. Engage with Garen Q Decisive Strike, silence him, then use Garen E Judgment. Activate Garen W Courage as Kennen’s counterattack comes in.
Kennen.laning: Don’t push the wave; pull it toward your side and dodge Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken from behind minions. Step forward briefly only to last-hit, then back off after a trade to recover health with Garen P Perseverance. Keep last-hitting to build Garen W Courage’s growth stacks.
Kennen.combo: If Kennen E Lightning Rush is on cooldown, attack in this order: Garen Q Decisive Strike → empowered basic attack to silence → Garen E Judgment. To finish him off, reduce his health with Garen E Judgment, then end the spin early and use Garen R Demacian Justice if Kennen tries to escape.
Kennen.escape: Engage after Kennen E Lightning Rush is used and there’s no risk of being stunned by Kennen P Mark of the Storm. If he has two stacks, back off first and approach again after the stacks disappear.
Kennen.phase: Survive early by avoiding Kennen’s poke and build Garen W Courage’s growth stacks. Garen becomes stronger as he builds up and peaks in mid game, so gain a lane advantage then and build on it with split-pushing. Late game, Garen E Judgment alone may not be enough, so use Garen R Demacian Justice on low-health opponents.
Kennen.teamfight: Avoid standing on top of your allies to dodge the area stun from Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom, and check your path into the fight with vision. When your team engages, activate Garen W Courage as the damage comes in, then go in and shred armor with Garen E Judgment. Finish off low-health opponents with Garen R Demacian Justice. If there’s no opening to engage, split-push.

Kayle.watch: Dodge Kayle Q Radiant Blast, which slows and reduces armor and magic resistance. If it hits you, use Garen Q Decisive Strike to remove the slow. Do not use Garen R Demacian Justice while Kayle R Divine Judgment's damage immunity is active.
Kayle.build: If Kayle's magic damage is threatening, buy Mercury's Treads for magic resistance and tenacity. If healing from Kayle W Celestial Blessing is disrupting your trades, buy Executioner's Calling early or rush Mortal Reminder.
Kayle.laning: If Garen E Judgment pushes the lane, retreat into a brush to let Garen P Perseverance restore your health, and keep a ward ready for ganks.
Kayle.combo: When engaging, close in with Garen Q Decisive Strike, apply the empowered attack's silence, then use Garen E Judgment. If Kayle is already on you, use Garen E Judgment first and save Q to use when you counterattack.
Kayle.escape: Kayle has no mobility ability, so look to engage after she uses the slow on Kayle Q Radiant Blast or the movement speed boost on Kayle W Celestial Blessing. If Q's slow hits you, remove it with Garen Q Decisive Strike and chase.
Kayle.teamfight: When your team starts a fight, activate Garen W Courage as the enemy attacks and look for a path to Kayle from the flank or outside vision. If Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, hold your damage. Wait it out with the silence from Garen Q Decisive Strike or your allies' crowd control, then finish her with Garen E Judgment and R Demacian Justice once the immunity ends.

KSante.build: Prioritize armor against K'Sante's physical damage, and build tenacity too if his Q and W crowd control keeps you locked down. Health is also needed because resistance does not mitigate the true damage from K'Sante W Path Maker.
KSante.laning: Afterward, pull the lane back and keep a ward ready so Garen, who has no mobility ability, does not get caught in a long lane. If Garen E Judgment pushes the lane, retreat into a brush or behind your turret to let Garen P Perseverance restore your health. Keep last-hitting to build stacks for Garen W Courage's armor growth.
KSante.combo: When engaging, use Garen Q Decisive Strike → empowered attack's silence → Garen E Judgment to stop K'Sante from retaliating. If he is already on you, start with Garen E Judgment and save Garen Q Decisive Strike to silence him with your first attack after the spin. To finish him, lower his health with Garen E Judgment, then use Garen R Demacian Justice. If he looks ready to escape, end E early and use R.
KSante.escape: Engage when both K'Sante W Path Maker and E Footwork are on cooldown. If only one is down, wait longer since he can escape with the other, and look especially for an opening before K'Sante R All Out comes back up. If the empowered shockwave from K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes is ready, move out of range first.
KSante.phase: In the late game, K'Sante's durability increases, making him hard to kill with Garen E Judgment alone. Use R to finish off enemies whose health is already low.
KSante.teamfight: When your team starts a fight, activate Garen W Courage as the enemy's ability hits and engage, then reduce K'Sante's armor with Garen E Judgment. Hold your damage while K'Sante W Path Maker is charging and sidestep the dash direction, then use Garen R Demacian Justice on him when his health is low. If you expect to fight for a long time while K'Sante R All Out is active, make sure your team has access to healing reduction. If there is no good angle to engage, split push.

Kled.watch: If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope catches you, create distance before it pulls you in, while Kled still needs to stay close. Remove the slow with Garen Q Decisive Strike, and time Garen W Courage for the pull. When Kled W Violent Tendencies is ready, back off so you do not take the fourth attack, which deals damage based on your maximum health.
Kled.fight: Keep your distance and trade briefly when Kled steps forward to last-hit minions. Do not stay in range long enough to take all four attacks from Kled W Violent Tendencies, and recover health with Garen P Perseverance after the trade. If Kled has dismounted from Skaarl, watch his courage meter and only fight to the finish when you can kill him.
Kled.laning: Pull the lane back and keep a ward ready to shorten the distance Kled can use for repeated engages. If Garen E Judgment pushes the lane, retreat into a brush and wait for Garen P Perseverance to restore your health. If Kled has dismounted from Skaarl, push him away from the lane so he cannot build courage on minions or your turret.
Kled.escape: Look to engage after both Kled E Jousting and R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! are on cooldown. If only one is down, do not chase recklessly since he can escape with the other. If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is also on cooldown, Garen Q Decisive Strike's movement speed makes it easier to catch him.
Kled.phase: In the early game, survive while watching out for Kled's catching abilities and Kled W Violent Tendencies. Mid game is when Garen is strongest, so secure your advantage through lane priority and split pushing. In the late game, Kled gets weaker, but Garen's damage from E Judgment alone also becomes insufficient, so look for a chance to use Garen R Demacian Justice on enemies with low health.
Kled.teamfight: Keep vision on the flank so you can see the direction Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is coming from. When your team starts a fight, activate Garen W Courage as the enemy attacks and engage, then reduce their armor with Garen E Judgment before using Garen R Demacian Justice on low-health enemies. If a frontal engage is difficult, look for an angle from the flank or outside vision. If there is no good teamfight angle, split push to keep an enemy occupied in a side lane.

Malphite.watch: If Malphite Q Seismic Shard hits you, its slow makes it hard to engage or retreat, so do not start a trade right after it hits. Malphite R Unstoppable Force is an unstoppable dash and cannot be interrupted by the silence from Garen Q Decisive Strike. When you cannot see Malphite, watch for a dash from an area without vision.
Malphite.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Malphite Q Seismic Shard, E Ground Slam, and R Unstoppable Force. Choose Mercury's Treads if magic damage and crowd control are threatening. If the enemy team has especially many slows, choose Boots of Swiftness to spend more time in range.
Malphite.fight: Trade when you can break Malphite P Granite Shield first and damage his actual health. If Malphite Q Seismic Shard hits you, remove the slow with Garen Q Decisive Strike before approaching, and engage after Malphite E Ground Slam is on cooldown. Reduce his armor with Garen E Judgment, then use Garen R Demacian Justice on Malphite when his health is low.
Malphite.laning: Keep the lane pulled back and have a ward ready. Recover with Garen P Perseverance after trades, and do not start a long trade while Malphite P Granite Shield is fully charged.
Malphite.combo: After breaking Malphite P Granite Shield, deal damage in this order: Garen Q Decisive Strike → empowered attack's silence → Garen E Judgment. If you are already on him, start with Garen E Judgment and save Garen Q Decisive Strike to silence him when he retaliates. To execute him, lower his health with Garen E Judgment, then use Garen R Demacian Justice.
Malphite.escape: If Malphite Q Seismic Shard hits you, remove the slow with Garen Q Decisive Strike and engage after Malphite E Ground Slam is on cooldown. Do not engage expecting to interrupt Malphite R Unstoppable Force with silence while it is still available.
Malphite.phase: In mid game, Garen is strong, so secure your advantage through lane priority and split pushing.
Malphite.teamfight: Keep your distance from allies so Malphite R Unstoppable Force cannot knock several of you up at once, and counterattack as soon as the dash is used. When your team starts a fight, activate Garen W Courage as the enemy's ability hits and engage, then reduce their armor with Garen E Judgment. Use Garen R Demacian Justice on low-health enemies. If there is no good angle to engage, split push to keep an enemy occupied in a side lane.

Mordekaiser.watch: If Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp pulls you in, it's easy to get hit by Mordekaiser Q Obliterate and then Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise. As Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp comes in, activate Garen W Courage to absorb it with your shield and tenacity. Once Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise is active, spend less time close to him. When Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready, don't enter its range alone.
Mordekaiser.build: Get magic resistance first to counter Mordekaiser's main damage, and consider Mercury's Treads. Armor is also valuable because he deals basic attack damage, but avoid stacking health alone with Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise in mind. If Mordekaiser W Indestructible's healing is a problem, buy Executioner's Calling early or complete Mortal Reminder sooner.
Mordekaiser.fight: Early on, trade once or twice briefly, then back off to avoid activating Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise. Look to commit your damage after Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp is down and Mordekaiser W Indestructible's shield has been depleted or it has switched to healing. However, if Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready, don't engage by entering its range alone.
Mordekaiser.laning: Keep the lane pushed toward you and ward. Trade briefly when Mordekaiser steps forward to last-hit, then retreat into a brush or behind your turret to recover with Garen P Perseverance. Last-hit minions to build Garen W Courage's armor and magic resistance as well.
Mordekaiser.combo: When you can safely get close, use Garen Q Decisive Strike to approach, land the empowered attack's silence, then follow with Garen E Judgment. If you're already close, start with Garen E Judgment and save Garen Q Decisive Strike's silence until he tries to retaliate. To finish him, damage him with Garen E Judgment before using Garen R Demacian Justice. If he looks ready to escape, end Garen E Judgment early and use your ultimate immediately.
Mordekaiser.escape: Engaging after Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp is down reduces the risk of being pulled in. Mordekaiser has no ability to create distance on his own, so check that you won't be trapped alone in Mordekaiser R Realm of Death, then commit when you get a chance to close in.
Mordekaiser.teamfight: If your team engages first, spread out so Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp doesn't pull several of you in together, and activate Garen W Courage as it comes in. Engage from the flank or outside vision, shred armor with Garen E Judgment, and finish low-health enemies with Garen R Demacian Justice. When Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready, don't enter its range alone. If there's no opening to engage, hold your ground on the side lane with Garen P Perseverance and split push.

Ornn.watch: Watch out for the slow from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and the pillar it leaves behind. Near the pillar or a wall, Ornn E Searing Charge can knock you up, so retreat toward open ground. If you're hit by the final burst of Ornn W Bellows Breath, keep your distance until Brittle wears off.
Ornn.build: If the enemy team has many slows, choose Boots of Swiftness instead of Berserker's Greaves. Ornn deals both physical and magic damage, so don't focus on only one type of resistance. Since Ornn W Bellows Breath deals damage based on your maximum health, you can prioritize tenacity over stacking health.
Ornn.fight: If you are slowed by Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture, cleanse it with Garen Q Decisive Strike and close in. Don't extend a chase while Ornn E Searing Charge and Ornn R Call of the Forge God are available. When Ornn's crowd control comes in, activate Garen W Courage to absorb it with your shield and tenacity.
Ornn.laning: Keep the lane pushed toward you and ward. Trade briefly when Ornn steps forward to last-hit. If Ornn tries to forge an item in lane, engage and attack him to interrupt the process. After the trade, back off and recover with Garen P Perseverance. Last-hit minions to build stacks of armor and magic resistance from Garen W Courage as well.
Ornn.combo: After cleansing the slow from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture, silence him with Garen Q Decisive Strike's empowered attack and follow with Garen E Judgment. If you're already close, start with Garen E Judgment, then activate Garen Q Decisive Strike as Ornn tries to retaliate so your first attack after the spin silences him. To finish him, damage him with Garen E Judgment before using Garen R Demacian Justice. If Ornn tries to escape, end Garen E Judgment early and use your ultimate.
Ornn.escape: Once Ornn E Searing Charge is down, you have a chance to approach, but Ornn can still escape with Ornn R Call of the Forge God if it's available. Look especially for an opening before Ornn R Call of the Forge God comes back, and save Garen Q Decisive Strike for the slow from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture.
Ornn.phase: Ornn's damage is low early, so look for chances to get ahead in lane. Mid game is when Garen is strongest, so press your lane advantage and split push to secure a lead. In the late game, Ornn's items and his team's Masterwork upgrades stack up, while Garen E Judgment alone becomes less likely to kill an opponent. Finish low-health enemies with Garen R Demacian Justice.
Ornn.teamfight: If your team engages first, activate Garen W Courage as the enemy's abilities hit, then move in. Hold the frontline with Garen E Judgment to shred armor, then use Garen R Demacian Justice on low-health enemies. Dodge the spirit from Ornn R Call of the Forge God to the side, and don't stand in a straight line where Ornn can counter-engage. If there's no opening to engage, split push to keep an enemy tied up in the side lane.

Nasus.watch: Nasus W Wither can slow and pin you down, so cleanse it with Garen Q Decisive Strike as soon as it hits. Nasus E Spirit Fire shreds armor, so don't stand in its area. If Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, stop fighting and wait out its duration.
Nasus.build: Build armor first against Nasus Q Siphoning Strike, his main source of damage. If the enemy team has many slows, choose Boots of Swiftness to reduce how long you can be pinned down. Nasus E Spirit Fire and Nasus R Fury of the Sands deal magic damage, so armor alone won't stop them.
Nasus.fight: After trading, recover with Garen P Perseverance from a position where you aren't being hit by the enemy champion.
Nasus.laning: Keep the lane pushed toward you so Nasus can't freely stack Nasus Q Siphoning Strike under his turret. Pressure him and call for a jungle gank when he steps up to last-hit. If Garen E Judgment pushes the lane, retreat into a brush to let Garen P Perseverance heal you and place a ward.
Nasus.combo: When approaching, use Garen Q Decisive Strike's movement speed to close in, land the empowered attack's silence, then follow with Garen E Judgment. If you're already close, start with Garen E Judgment and save Garen Q Decisive Strike to silence Nasus when he retaliates. To finish him, damage him with Garen E Judgment before using Garen R Demacian Justice.
Nasus.escape: Once Nasus W Wither is down, you have a chance to engage without being pinned by its slow. Nasus has no ability to create distance on his own, so use Garen Q Decisive Strike to close in when you get an opening. If Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, wait until its duration ends before engaging.
Nasus.phase: Mid game is when Garen is strongest, so press your lane advantage and split push to secure a lead. As the game goes on, Nasus's stacks grow permanently and Garen becomes more reliant on finishing enemies.
Nasus.teamfight: If your team engages first, activate Garen W Courage as the enemy's attacks come in, then move in. Shred enemy armor with Garen E Judgment, then use Garen R Demacian Justice on low-health enemies. If a direct engage is difficult, look for an opening from the flank or outside vision. If there's no teamfight opening, split push to keep an enemy occupied in the side lane.

Olaf.watch: Olaf Q Undertow shreds armor and slows you, so move opposite the direction the axe lands to prevent him from picking it up. If you're slowed, cleanse it with Garen Q Decisive Strike and create distance. Olaf E Reckless Swing deals true damage, so don't rely on armor alone to survive at low health.
Olaf.build: Build armor first against Olaf Q Undertow and his basic attacks. Olaf E Reckless Swing's true damage can't be reduced by armor, so build health too. If the enemy team has many slows, choose Boots of Swiftness instead of Berserker's Greaves.
Olaf.fight: Don't fight Olaf for long early on. Trade briefly when he steps forward to last-hit. Cleanse the slow from Olaf Q Undertow with Garen Q Decisive Strike, and use Garen W Courage's shield when Olaf E Reckless Swing hits. Olaf gains attack speed and healing at low health, so don't drag out a fight you can't finish.
Olaf.laning: Keep the lane pushed toward you and ward so Garen, who has no mobility ability, isn't pressured while overextended. Move opposite the direction Olaf Q Undertow's axe lands to prevent him from picking it up. After trading, back off and recover with Garen P Perseverance. Last-hit minions to build Garen W Courage's defensive stats as well.
Olaf.combo: When approaching, use Garen Q Decisive Strike to close in, land the empowered attack's silence, then use Garen E Judgment. If Olaf is already close, start with Garen E Judgment and save Garen Q Decisive Strike to silence him with your first attack after the spin. To finish him, damage him with Garen E Judgment before using Garen R Demacian Justice.
Olaf.escape: Look to approach when Olaf Q Undertow misses and he can't pick up the axe. Olaf has no ability to create distance on his own, so use Garen Q Decisive Strike to close in and trade briefly during that window. If Olaf R Ragnarok is active, create distance and wait it out, then engage again when it ends.
Olaf.phase: Olaf is strong early, so survive by avoiding deaths and keeping the lane pushed toward you. Garen grows stronger in the mid game, so press your lane advantage and split push to secure a lead. Olaf is relatively weaker late, but Garen E Judgment may not deal enough damage on its own, so use Garen R Demacian Justice on low-health enemies.
Olaf.teamfight: After your team engages, activate Garen W Courage as the enemy attacks come in, then move in. Hold the frontline with Garen E Judgment to shred armor, then use Garen R Demacian Justice on low-health enemies. If a direct engage is difficult, look for an opening from the flank or outside vision. If there's no teamfight opening, split push to keep an enemy tied up in the side lane.

Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault targets and stuns, so it’s important not to give him its range. When it hits, activate Garen W Courage to absorb it with a shield and tenacity. Pantheon E Aegis Assault blocks damage in the direction he faces, so stop attacking from the front and wait for it to end or move around to the side.
Pantheon.build: Pantheon’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on your maximum health, and Pantheon R Grand Starfall has armor penetration, so don’t rely on stacking only health or armor.
Pantheon.fight: Engage when Pantheon W Shield Vault is down and Pantheon R Grand Starfall is unavailable. When Pantheon E Aegis Assault comes out, don’t pour damage into it from the front; wait for it to end or move to the side.
Pantheon.laning: Pull the lane and keep wards up so you don’t easily give Pantheon W Shield Vault its range. When Pantheon Q Comet Spear pokes you, stand behind minions to reduce the damage. After trading, retreat and recover with Garen P Perseverance, and last-hit to build Garen W Courage’s armor growth.
Pantheon.combo: When closing in, approach with Garen Q Decisive Strike, apply the empowered attack’s silence, then use Garen E Judgment. If you’re already in range, use Garen E Judgment first and save Garen Q Decisive Strike to use in response to his counterattack. After Pantheon E Aegis Assault ends or you get to his side, deal enough damage, then finish Garen E Judgment or end it early and use Garen R Demacian Justice to finish him.
Pantheon.escape: Your window to engage is after Pantheon W Shield Vault is down and before Pantheon R Grand Starfall comes back up. If only Pantheon W Shield Vault is down, he can escape with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, so check whether he still has another way to move.
Pantheon.phase: Pantheon’s influence falls off late, but Garen may also struggle to finish opponents with Garen E Judgment alone, so use Garen R Demacian Justice on opponents whose health is low.
Pantheon.teamfight: When your team starts a fight, engage from the flank or out of vision, and activate Garen W Courage as Pantheon W Shield Vault comes in. Hold your ground while Garen E Judgment reduces his armor, then use Garen R Demacian Justice on an opponent whose health is low. When you see the landing warning for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of its landing area. If there’s no angle to engage, split-push in a side lane.

Poppy.build: Build armor first to mitigate Poppy’s main damage. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that add a lot of health alone. If the enemy team has a lot of slows, choose Boots of Swiftness instead of Berserker’s Greaves.
Poppy.fight: Walk in to close the gap right after Poppy E Heroic Charge is used. If you’re slowed by Poppy Q Hammer Shock, cleanse it with Garen Q Decisive Strike and approach, but first leave the remaining zone. When Poppy E Heroic Charge comes in, activate Garen W Courage to absorb it with a shield and tenacity.
Poppy.laning: Pull the lane and stay in open space to avoid being knocked into a wall by Poppy E Heroic Charge. Trade briefly when Poppy steps forward to last-hit minions, then retreat afterward to recover with Garen P Perseverance. When the shield thrown by Poppy P Iron Ambassador lands, step on it first to deny her shield.
Poppy.combo: Cleanse Poppy Q Hammer Shock’s slow with Garen Q Decisive Strike, then silence her with the empowered attack and use Garen E Judgment. If Poppy is already in range, use Garen E Judgment first and save Garen Q Decisive Strike to land the empowered attack when she tries to counterattack. When you’re sure you can finish her, reduce her health with Garen E Judgment, then use Garen R Demacian Justice.
Poppy.phase: Early on, watch out for Poppy’s wall stun and follow-up attacks; pull the lane and hold on. Garen gets stronger as he gains growth stacks, and reaches his peak in the mid game, so turn your lane advantage and split-push into a lead then. Late game, Garen E Judgment alone may not be enough, so look for an angle to use Garen R Demacian Justice on an opponent whose health is low.

Quinn.watch: When Quinn P Harrier marks you, move out of her attack range so you don’t get hit by the empowered attack. Dodge Quinn Q Blinding Assault from behind the minion line. Use Garen W Courage as Quinn E Vault comes in to absorb its slow and knockback, then cleanse the slow with Garen Q Decisive Strike.
Quinn.build: Quinn’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. If the enemy team has a lot of slows, choose Boots of Swiftness instead of Berserker’s Greaves.
Quinn.fight: Early on, don’t engage first on your own because of the range disadvantage. Close the gap and start a trade after Quinn E Vault is used or when your jungler arrives. Look for moments when Quinn P Harrier’s mark is absent.
Quinn.laning: Pull the lane while protecting your CS and health, and stand behind the minion line to block Quinn Q Blinding Assault. If Quinn P Harrier marks you, back off, then last-hit while the mark is absent. After a trade, recover with Garen P Perseverance in a brush or behind your turret. If you’ve pushed the lane, place a ward.
Quinn.combo: After Quinn E Vault is used, approach with Garen Q Decisive Strike, apply the empowered attack’s silence, then use Garen E Judgment. If Quinn slows you, use Garen Q Decisive Strike immediately afterward to cleanse it. To finish her, reduce her health with Garen E Judgment, then use Garen R Demacian Justice. If Quinn tries to escape, end Garen E Judgment early.
Quinn.escape: Your window to engage is right after Quinn E Vault is used. Before then, she can knock you back and create distance again, so don’t force an engage. Cleanse Quinn E Vault’s slow with Garen Q Decisive Strike and chase.
Quinn.phase: Early on, Quinn pressures you with her range, so Garen should hold on while protecting CS and health. Garen gets better at dealing with her as he grows stronger, and reaches his peak in the mid game, so turn your lane advantage and split-push into a lead then. Late game, Garen E Judgment alone may not be enough to finish opponents, so use Garen R Demacian Justice on an opponent whose health is low.
Quinn.teamfight: When your team starts a fight, time Garen W Courage to absorb the enemy’s attack, then engage and reduce their armor with Garen E Judgment. Approach from the flank or out of vision, and use Garen R Demacian Justice on Quinn when her health is low.

Rumble.watch: Rumble Q Flamespitter is more likely to hit you at close range, so create distance as soon as a trade ends. When Rumble E Electro Harpoon’s first shot hits you, cleanse the slow with Garen Q Decisive Strike and back away to dodge the second harpoon. Against Rumble R The Equalizer’s slow and follow-up damage, time Garen W Courage to the moment the ability hits.
Rumble.build: Prioritize defensive items with magic resistance to prepare for the magic damage from Rumble P Junkyard Titan, Q Flamespitter, and E Electro Harpoon. Choose Mercury’s Treads if magic damage and crowd control are threatening, or Boots of Swiftness if the enemy team has many slows overall.
Rumble.fight: Don’t stay in Rumble Q Flamespitter for long; trade briefly when Rumble steps forward to last-hit minions. If Rumble activates Rumble W Scrap Shield, save your burst until the shield disappears. Then close in with Garen Q Decisive Strike, silence him, and use Garen E Judgment.
Rumble.laning: Pull the lane to make Rumble walk forward, and keep wards up to prepare for ganks. After a trade, retreat somewhere Rumble can’t reach and recover health with Garen P Perseverance. Also last-hit to build Garen W Courage’s resistance growth stacks.
Rumble.combo: When engaging, attack in this order: Garen Q Decisive Strike → empowered attack for silence → Garen E Judgment. If you’re already in range, use Garen E Judgment first and save Garen Q Decisive Strike for Rumble’s counterattack, then land the empowered attack after the spin. To execute him, reduce his health with Garen E Judgment, then use Garen R Demacian Justice. If Rumble tries to escape, end E early and use R.
Rumble.escape: Your chance to engage comes after Rumble W Scrap Shield’s shield and movement speed boost wear off. If you cleanse Rumble E Electro Harpoon’s slow with Garen Q Decisive Strike, first create enough distance to dodge the second harpoon. Rumble has no mobility ability, so don’t hesitate to go in when you get another chance to close the gap.
Rumble.phase: Early on, hold on while avoiding prolonged exposure to Rumble Q Flamespitter, and make use of Garen P Perseverance’s healing and Garen W Courage’s growth stacks. Garen gains an advantage as he stacks up and is strong in the mid game, so turn your lane advantage and split-push into a lead then. Late game, Garen E Judgment alone may not be enough to take down opponents, so focus on finishing enemies whose health is low with Garen R Demacian Justice.
Rumble.teamfight: When your team starts a fight, activate Garen W Courage as Rumble’s abilities come in, then engage. Hold your ground while Garen E Judgment reduces the enemy’s armor, then use Garen R Demacian Justice on an enemy whose health is low. If it’s hard to engage from the front, look for an angle from the flank or out of vision. If there’s no teamfight angle, split-push to keep an opponent occupied in a side lane.

Renekton.watch: When Renekton P Reign of Anger pushes his Fury above half, stay out of range of empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator's stun. Even just below half, he can build Fury with basic attacks or Renekton Q Cull the Meek, so stay alert.
Renekton.build: If Renekton Q Cull the Meek's healing makes trades difficult, get Executioner's Calling early to reduce healing and work toward Mortal Reminder sooner. Build armor first against Renekton's main Q, W, and E damage. Also account for Renekton R Dominus's magic damage and empowered Renekton E Slice and Dice's armor reduction when positioning.
Renekton.fight: Trade when Renekton is out of Fury, and retaliate after he uses Q, W, and E. When Renekton W Ruthless Predator comes in, time Garen W Courage to counter the stun, but don't rely on its shield to trade because empowered W breaks the shield first. If Renekton E Slice and Dice is used to disengage, close the distance with Garen Q Decisive Strike's movement speed.
Renekton.laning: Let the wave push toward you and keep wards up. Trade when Renekton steps forward to last-hit. Be careful with your position: standing in or behind a minion wave can give Renekton E Slice and Dice a launch point. After trading, back off and heal with Garen P Perseverance, and collect last hits to build the armor from Garen W Courage.
Renekton.combo: To close the gap, use Garen Q Decisive Strike → empowered basic attack to silence → Garen E Judgment. To finish, lower their health with E, then use Garen R Demacian Justice. If Renekton tries to escape, end E early and cast R.
Renekton.escape: The moment after Renekton uses E Slice and Dice is your window to engage. This is especially true if he used E to disengage and has also spent Q and W: close in with Garen Q Decisive Strike and retaliate. Delay your engage if Renekton has Fury and empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator ready.
Renekton.phase: Garen is strong in the mid game, so press your lane advantage and split push to build your lead. Renekton's value falls over time, improving the matchup, but in the late game Garen E Judgment alone may not be enough. Look for chances to execute with Garen R Demacian Justice.
Renekton.teamfight: When your team starts a fight, activate Garen W Courage as the enemy attacks, then engage and reduce their armor with Garen E Judgment. Use Garen R Demacian Justice on low-health enemies, and look for an angle from the flank or out of vision when engaging. If there is no good teamfight angle, hold a side lane with Garen P Perseverance and keep one opponent occupied.

Riven.build: Riven's main damage is physical, so build armor first. If Riven gets ahead, move armor items earlier in your build and get enough health to survive her finishing damage. When adding damage, choose attack speed and critical strike to strengthen Garen E Judgment.
Riven.fight: Trade briefly when Riven steps forward to last-hit after using Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions. If Riven engages first, use Garen W Courage to absorb the engage damage and crowd control, then interrupt her remaining combo with the silence from Garen Q Decisive Strike. Don't chase far while Riven Q Broken Wings is available.
Riven.laning: Let the wave push toward you and keep wards up to limit how far Riven can chase with her chained dashes. Retaliate when Riven Q Broken Wings is used on the wave. After trading, move somewhere you won't be hit by a champion and heal with Garen P Perseverance. Last-hitting also helps build the armor from Garen W Courage.
Riven.combo: When Riven uses a skill and steps forward, close in with Garen Q Decisive Strike, silence her with the empowered basic attack, then follow with Garen E Judgment. If Riven engages first, use Garen E Judgment while preparing Garen Q Decisive Strike, then block her counterattack with the silence from your first basic attack after the spin. To execute, lower her health with Garen E Judgment, then use Garen R Demacian Justice. If Riven tries to escape, end Garen E Judgment early and cast R.
Riven.escape: Engage after Riven Q Broken Wings is down and before she can use it again. If only Riven E Valor is down, she can still escape with another dash, so track whether both Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor have been used.
Riven.phase: Garen is strong in short melee trades early, but beware Riven's chained dashes and let the wave push toward you to hold your ground. Garen is strongest in the mid game, so press your lane advantage and split push to build your lead. Garen's scaling advantage grows later, but Garen E Judgment alone may not be enough in the late game, so use Garen R Demacian Justice on low-health enemies.
Riven.teamfight: If your team starts the fight, activate Garen W Courage as Riven engages, then hold the frontline while reducing enemy armor with Garen E Judgment. Watch for the threat of Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven W Ki Burst, and use Garen R Demacian Justice on low-health enemies. If a frontal engage is difficult, look for an angle from the flank or out of vision. If there is no good fight angle, split push to keep an opponent in a side lane.

Sett.build: Build armor first to reduce the damage from Sett P Pit Grit and Sett Q Knuckle Down. Sett Q Knuckle Down scales with your max health, and resistance can't reduce the true damage at the center of Sett W Haymaker, so don't rely on stacking health alone. If the enemy team has many slows, choose Boots of Swiftness instead of Berserker's Greaves.
Sett.fight: Manage your distance to avoid the stun angle from Sett E Facebreaker, and trade briefly when Sett steps up to last-hit. After dealing damage, briefly back off to avoid Sett W Haymaker, then go back in when his Grit has cooled down.
Sett.laning: Garen has no mobility, so if Sett catches you, he can easily follow up with more hits. Let the wave push toward you and keep wards up. After trading, create distance to avoid the threat of Sett W Haymaker, then recover health with Garen P Perseverance in a bush or behind your turret.
Sett.combo: If you can engage first, close in with Garen Q Decisive Strike, silence with the empowered basic attack, then use Garen E Judgment. If Sett is already on you, use Garen E Judgment first and save Garen Q Decisive Strike until the spin ends, then silence him with the empowered basic attack. To finish, lower his health with Garen Q Decisive Strike → empowered basic attack → Garen E Judgment, then use Garen R Demacian Justice. If Sett tries to escape, end E early and cast R.
Sett.escape: Engage when Sett E Facebreaker is down and the stun threat is gone. If Sett has also used Sett W Haymaker, wait for his Grit to cool down before going back in.
Sett.phase: Garen can hold his ground early with melee trades and healing, but prioritize keeping your distance because if Sett catches you once, he can easily follow up with more hits. Get through the early game while building Garen's growth stacks; the matchup gets better as the game goes on, and Garen gets strong in the mid game, so press your lane advantage and split push to build your lead. In the late game, Garen E Judgment alone may not be enough, so focus on using Garen R Demacian Justice on low-health enemies.
Sett.teamfight: If your team starts the fight, activate Garen W Courage as the enemy's skills come in, then engage. Reduce armor with Garen E Judgment and hold the frontline, then use Garen R Demacian Justice on low-health enemies. If a frontal engage is difficult, look for an angle from the flank or out of vision. If there is no good teamfight angle, pressure a side lane while using Garen P Perseverance to recover.

Shen.build: Prioritize tenacity against the taunt from Shen E Shadow Dash. Shen E Shadow Dash deals physical damage and Shen Q Twilight Assault deals magic damage, so don't focus on just one resistance if you build defenses. If the enemy team has many slows, choose Boots of Swiftness instead of Berserker's Greaves.
Shen.fight: Trade right after Shen E Shadow Dash misses. If Shen W Spirit's Refuge is active, save Garen Q Decisive Strike's empowered basic attack and deal damage with Garen E Judgment, which works through the zone. If you've been slowed by Shen Q Twilight Assault, cleanse it with Garen Q Decisive Strike and close in.
Shen.laning: Trade when Shen steps up to last-hit and take control of the lane. If Garen E Judgment pushes the wave, retreat into a bush to let Garen P Perseverance heal you, and keep wards up against ganks.
Shen.combo: If Shen W Spirit's Refuge is down, use Garen Q Decisive Strike → empowered basic attack to silence → Garen E Judgment. If Shen is already on you or has activated the zone, use Garen E Judgment first and land Garen Q Decisive Strike's empowered basic attack after the zone ends. To finish, lower his health with Garen E Judgment, then use Garen R Demacian Justice. If he looks ready to escape, end Garen E Judgment early and cast R immediately.
Shen.escape: If Shen E Shadow Dash misses, both his taunt and mobility are down, giving you a window to retaliate. If Shen R Stand United is not ready, Shen also has fewer ways to escape. Keep in mind that if only Shen E Shadow Dash is down, he can still escape with Shen R Stand United.
Shen.phase: Garen is strong in melee trades early, while Shen is weak in lane, so look to take control. In the late game, Garen E Judgment alone may struggle to get through enemy durability, so use Garen R Demacian Justice to execute.
