Shen.teamfight: While Shen R Stand United is available, Shen can join fights elsewhere, so avoid fights you can't finish before he arrives. When a fight starts, let an ally engage first, then activate Garen W Courage as the enemy uses a skill and engage, reducing armor with Garen E Judgment. Use Garen R Demacian Justice on low-health enemies, and if there's no way in, keep opponents occupied in a side lane.

Singed.watch: Chasing Singed through Singed Q Poison Trail means you keep walking through the poison. Go around areas covered by Singed W Mega Adhesive and keep your distance so Singed E Fling can’t catch you while you’re on it.
Singed.build: Singed E Fling deals damage based on your maximum health, so stacking health alone is inefficient.
Singed.fight: Trade briefly when Singed steps up to last-hit. If Singed W Mega Adhesive slows you, cleanse it with Garen Q Decisive Strike and close the gap. When Singed E Fling is about to hit, activate Garen W Courage to use its shield and tenacity.
Singed.laning: Let the wave push toward you and keep a ward ready. If Garen E Judgment pushes the wave out, back off briefly and recover health with Garen P Perseverance. Don’t chase a low-health Singed through Singed Q Poison Trail.
Singed.combo: When you can approach, attack in this order: Garen Q Decisive Strike → empowered attack for the silence → Garen E Judgment. If you’re already in melee range, use Garen E Judgment first and save Garen Q Decisive Strike for when you need to trade back. If you can execute him, lower his health with Garen E Judgment, then use Garen R Demacian Justice.
Singed.escape: Go around Singed W Mega Adhesive; your opening to engage comes after Singed E Fling is down. Singed has no ability to create distance on his own, so when you see an angle to get close, use the movement speed from Garen Q Decisive Strike to approach.
Singed.phase: If you survive the early game, Garen gains an advantage as he scales and is strongest in the mid game, so press your lane advantage and secure it with split pushing. In the late game, Garen E Judgment alone may not be enough, making it important to find chances to use Garen R Demacian Justice on low-health enemies.
Singed.teamfight: Don’t chase Singed to the end. When your allies engage, activate Garen W Courage to line up with the incoming fight and go in. Use Garen E Judgment to reduce armor and hold the frontline, then cast Garen R Demacian Justice on low-health enemies. If a direct engage is difficult, look for an angle from the flank or out of vision; if there’s no teamfight opening, apply pressure in a side lane.

Sion.watch: If you let Sion charge Sion Q Decimating Smash for too long, it can stun and knock you up, so move to the side as soon as he starts charging. Sion E Roar of the Slayer slows you and reduces your armor, so dodge it; if it slows you, cleanse it with Garen Q Decisive Strike. Don’t meet Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught in a narrow path; sidestep to avoid it.
Sion.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Sion P Glory in Death, Q Decimating Smash, and R Unstoppable Onslaught. However, Sion E Roar of the Slayer reduces your armor, so dodging his abilities is also important. If the enemy team has a lot of slows, choose Boots of Swiftness instead of Berserker’s Greaves.
Sion.fight: Approach after dodging Sion Q Decimating Smash to the side or making him cast it early. When Sion W Soul Furnace is active, focus your damage to break its shield before it explodes. Activate Garen W Courage when Sion’s attack is about to land to use its shield and tenacity.
Sion.laning: Let the wave push toward you and trade when Sion steps up to last-hit. If Garen E Judgment pushes the wave out, retreat into a brush or behind your turret to recover with Garen P Perseverance, and keep a ward ready for ganks. Sion gains maximum health by killing units, so disrupt his farming when you can apply pressure rather than continually giving him last hits.
Sion.combo: When approaching, use Garen Q Decisive Strike to close the gap, silence him with the empowered attack, then follow with Garen E Judgment. If you’re already in melee range and need to prepare for Sion’s slow, use Garen E Judgment first and save Garen Q Decisive Strike. To finish him, lower Sion’s health with Garen E Judgment, then use Garen R Demacian Justice; if he looks ready to escape, end the spin early and cast your ultimate.
Sion.escape: If you’ve also dodged Sion Q Decimating Smash or made him cast it early, there’s less risk of being caught. If Sion E Roar of the Slayer slows you during your engage, cleanse it with Garen Q Decisive Strike and close the gap.
Sion.phase: In the early game, use Garen’s health and Garen P Perseverance to survive while dodging Sion’s crowd control. Garen is strongest in the mid game, so build a lane advantage and secure it with split pushing. In the late game, Garen E Judgment alone may not be enough, so look for chances to finish low-health enemies with Garen R Demacian Justice.
Sion.teamfight: When your allies engage first, activate Garen W Courage as Sion’s abilities come in, then go in. Use Garen E Judgment to reduce enemy armor and hold the frontline, then cast Garen R Demacian Justice on low-health enemies. If a direct engage is difficult, look for an angle from the flank or out of vision; if there’s no teamfight opening, keep Sion occupied in a side lane.

TahmKench.watch: Cleanse the slow from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash with Garen Q Decisive Strike. Use Garen W Courage to absorb the knock-up from Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive as he arrives.
TahmKench.build: Tahm Kench’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first and consider Mercury’s Treads, which also grant tenacity. If healing from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and E Thick Skin makes the duel drag on, buy Executioner’s Calling early to apply Grievous Wounds. Since he has high armor, add penetration later or make use of the armor reduction from Garen E Judgment and the true damage from R Demacian Justice.
TahmKench.fight: Fight when Tahm Kench has no stacks and Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is on cooldown. If you only hit him a little at a time, Tahm Kench E Thick Skin will heal him, so when you engage, burst him with the silence from Garen Q Decisive Strike and the damage from E Judgment. If you need to cleanse the slow from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash, save Garen Q Decisive Strike until right after it hits.
TahmKench.laning: Let the wave push toward you and keep a ward ready; trade when Tahm Kench steps up to last-hit. If you think Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste has reached two stacks, wait out of his range until they disappear. After trading, back off briefly to recover with Garen P Perseverance, and collect last hits to build Garen W Courage’s resistances.
TahmKench.combo: If you don’t need to cleanse the slow from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash, deal damage in this order: Garen Q Decisive Strike → empowered attack for the silence → E Judgment. If you’re already in melee range, use Garen E Judgment first and save Q Decisive Strike to use when he retaliates. To finish him, lower his health with E Judgment, then, if needed, end the spin early and use R Demacian Justice.
TahmKench.escape: Your opening to engage comes after Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is on cooldown. If Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash slows you, cleanse it with Garen Q Decisive Strike, then manage your distance. If you think Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste has reached two stacks, don’t engage; back away.
TahmKench.phase: In the early game, hold the lane while watching Tahm Kench’s stacks and ways to catch you. Garen gets stronger as he builds defensive stats and peaks in the mid game, so build a lane advantage then and secure it with split pushing. In the late game, it becomes difficult to take down Tahm Kench with Garen E Judgment alone, so Garen R Demacian Justice plays a bigger role in finishing low-health enemies.
TahmKench.teamfight: When your allies engage, activate Garen W Courage as the enemy’s abilities come in, then go in and reduce armor with E Judgment. If Tahm Kench R Devour is available, he may swallow the enemy you’re trying to finish, so account for the shield they get after being spat out when using R Demacian Justice. If a direct engage is difficult, look for an opening from the flank or switch to split pushing.

Skarner.watch: If Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact catches you and slams you into a wall, you’ll be stunned and its charge cooldown will be shorter, so don’t stand with a wall behind you. Skarner R Impale suppresses and drags you, and silence can’t interrupt it, so don’t stay within its range for long. Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval empowered attacks and Skarner P Threads of Vibration are more dangerous the closer you are, so keep your distance first.
Skarner.laning: Let the wave push toward you and keep a ward ready to reduce the chance of Garen, who has no mobility ability, getting caught in an extended lane. Look to trade when Skarner steps up to last-hit and has used Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact. After trading, move somewhere you won’t be hit by a champion and recover health with Garen P Perseverance. Collect last hits to build Garen W Courage’s defensive stats.
Skarner.combo: If Skarner is at a distance and has slowed you, cleanse it with Garen Q Decisive Strike, silence him with the empowered attack, then use Garen E Judgment. If you’re already in melee range, use Garen E Judgment first and save Garen Q Decisive Strike to silence him with your first attack after the spin ends. To finish him, lower his health with Garen E Judgment, then use Garen R Demacian Justice; if he looks ready to escape, end Garen E Judgment early.
Skarner.phase: In the early game, let the wave push toward you and survive while watching for Skarner’s ways to catch you. Garen gains an advantage against this opponent as he builds up and peaks in the mid game, so secure the lane advantage you earn then with split pushing. In the late game, Skarner becomes more durable, making him difficult to catch with Garen E Judgment alone, so finish low-health enemies with Garen R Demacian Justice.
Skarner.teamfight: Watch out for Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact by avoiding walls and the edges of objective pits, and keep your distance from Skarner and his allies. When your allies engage, activate Garen W Courage as the incoming attacks land and go in; reduce armor with Garen E Judgment, then use Garen R Demacian Justice on low-health enemies. If there’s no angle to engage, hold an enemy in a side lane while recovering with Garen P Perseverance.

Trundle.watch: Trundle Q Chomp reduces your attack damage and puts you at a disadvantage in trades, so back off until the effect ends. Don’t fight on Trundle W Frozen Domain; step outside and wait out its duration. Trundle E Pillar of Ice blocks your escape and slows you, so avoid narrow paths and immediately move to the side when the pillar appears.
Trundle.build: Trundle’s main damage comes from basic attacks and Trundle Q Chomp, so build armor first. If slows make it hard to stick to him, buy Boots of Swiftness. If Trundle’s healing shuts down your trades, buy Executioner’s Calling early and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder. Trundle R Subjugate reduces your resistances and deals damage based on your max health, so create distance while it’s active instead of stacking only resistances or health.
Trundle.fight: Take short trades after Trundle Q Chomp’s attack damage reduction ends and you’re outside Trundle W Frozen Domain. If you’re slowed by Trundle E Pillar of Ice, cleanse it with Garen Q Decisive Strike and close in; engage on open ground after the pillar is gone. Don’t keep fighting head-on while Trundle R Subjugate is active; create distance.
Trundle.laning: Early on, let the wave push toward you and keep wards up. Trade when Trundle steps forward to last-hit. Trundle P King’s Tribute heals him whenever a nearby unit dies, so if you’ve chipped away at his health, secure your advantage right away or push the wave to force him to recall. After trading, retreat into a brush or behind your turret to heal with Garen P Perseverance, and last-hit to build Garen W Courage’s defensive stats.
Trundle.combo: If you need to cleanse Trundle E Pillar of Ice’s slow to get close, trade in this order: Garen Q Decisive Strike → empowered basic attack to silence → Garen E Judgment. If Trundle is already on you, use Garen E Judgment first and save Garen Q Decisive Strike; after the spin, silence him with the empowered basic attack. To finish him, wear down his health with Garen E Judgment, then use Garen R Demacian Justice. If he looks ready to flee, end the spin early and use it.
Trundle.escape: Engage after Trundle E Pillar of Ice is down and from outside Trundle W Frozen Domain. Trundle has no skill to create distance on his own, so use Garen Q Decisive Strike to close in and silence him. If you were slowed by the pillar first, cleanse it with Garen Q Decisive Strike. Don’t engage in a narrow path where the pillar blocks your escape.
Trundle.teamfight: Hold the front line with Garen E Judgment to reduce armor, then use Garen R Demacian Justice on low-health enemies. While Trundle R Subjugate is active and he’s become tankier, attack another target or create distance.

Teemo.watch: If you’re hit by Teemo Q Blinding Dart, it nullifies Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered basic attack, so don’t try to basic attack before the blind wears off. Teemo E Toxic Shot keeps dealing poison damage after even one basic attack, so stay outside its range unless you’re ready to commit. Watch for Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare’s stealth in unwarded brushes, and beware of the slow from Teemo R Noxious Trap around key paths.
Teemo.build: Teemo’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If magic damage and crowd control are a threat, get Mercury’s Treads for magic resistance and tenacity. If frequent slows make it hard to chase, choose Boots of Swiftness.
Teemo.fight: Look for a trade after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down. Use Garen Q Decisive Strike’s movement speed to close in at once, and time Garen W Courage to absorb Teemo’s counterattack. If you’re blinded, deal damage with Garen E Judgment instead of basic attacks, or back off.
Teemo.laning: Generally, let the wave push toward you and keep wards up. Don’t stay within Teemo E Toxic Shot’s range when you aren’t ready to engage. Trade when Teemo steps forward to last-hit and Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down. After trading, retreat to safety and heal with Garen P Perseverance. When moving in with your jungler, push the wave to pressure Teemo.
Teemo.combo: If Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down, close in with Garen Q Decisive Strike, silence him with the empowered basic attack, then use Garen E Judgment. If you’re already on him when blinded, use Garen E Judgment first, then land Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered basic attack once the blind wears off. To finish him, wear down his health with Garen E Judgment, then use Garen R Demacian Justice.
Teemo.escape: Engaging while Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down reduces the risk of your empowered basic attack being nullified. If Teemo slows you with Teemo R Noxious Trap, cleanse it with Garen Q Decisive Strike and close the gap. Teemo has no way to create distance besides Teemo W Move Quick, so once you get on him, keep trading until the exchange is over.
Teemo.phase: Early on, survive Teemo’s basic attack poison and blind, and manage your health with Garen P Perseverance. Garen grows stronger over time, so the matchup becomes relatively favorable after you get through the early game. In the mid game, turn your lane advantage and split pushing into a lasting lead. In the late game, Garen E Judgment alone may not be enough, so focus on using Garen R Demacian Justice to finish off low-health opponents.
Teemo.teamfight: Use Oracle Lens to find and clear Teemo R Noxious Trap around objectives and in narrow passages. If your team engages first, activate Garen W Courage as the enemy attacks, then move in and reduce armor with Garen E Judgment. Use Garen R Demacian Justice on low-health enemies. If there’s no good angle to engage, split push to keep an opponent occupied in a side lane.

Tryndamere.watch: Tryndamere P Battle Fury’s stored Fury grants critical chance and healing from Tryndamere Q Bloodlust, so create distance when he builds Fury by attacking minions. Tryndamere W Mocking Shout slows you when you turn away to retreat, so walk backward while facing him and cleanse the slow with Garen Q Decisive Strike. Tryndamere R Undying Rage makes him unable to die, so create distance and wait out its duration.
Tryndamere.build: Build armor first against Tryndamere’s main damage and critical strikes, and consider Thornmail to counter an opponent who relies on basic attacks. If healing from Tryndamere Q Bloodlust is a problem, get Executioner’s Calling early for Grievous Wounds or upgrade to Mortal Reminder sooner. If slows are frequent, choose Boots of Swiftness instead of Berserker’s Greaves.
Tryndamere.fight: Close the gap for a short trade right after Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down. As you approach, silence him with Garen Q Decisive Strike, then use Garen E Judgment, and activate Garen W Courage when his damage lands. If Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, back off instead of unloading your attacks, then fight again after it expires.
Tryndamere.laning: Early on, pressure Tryndamere so he can’t build Fury by last-hitting, but create distance once he starts building it. Let the wave push toward you and keep wards up. Trade when Tryndamere steps forward to last-hit. After trading, back off briefly to heal with Garen P Perseverance, and last-hit to build Garen W Courage’s armor growth.
Tryndamere.combo: After Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down, attack in this order: Garen Q Decisive Strike → empowered basic attack to silence → Garen E Judgment. If Tryndamere is already on you, use Garen E Judgment first and save Garen Q Decisive Strike; after the spin ends, silence him with the empowered basic attack. Once Tryndamere R Undying Rage ends, wear down his health with Garen E Judgment and finish him with Garen R Demacian Justice.
Tryndamere.phase: Early on, survive while watching Tryndamere’s Fury and critical strikes, and pressure his last-hitting to reduce his healing as well. Garen grows stronger as he builds stacks and peaks in the mid game, so turn your lane advantage and split pushing then into a lasting lead. In the late game, Garen E Judgment alone may not be enough, so look for an opening to use Garen R Demacian Justice on a low-health opponent.
Tryndamere.teamfight: If your team engages first, activate Garen W Courage as the enemy attacks, then move in and reduce armor with Garen E Judgment. Use Garen R Demacian Justice on low-health enemies, but create distance and wait out Tryndamere R Undying Rage while it’s active. If teamfighting is difficult and you move to a side lane, check whether Tryndamere R Undying Rage is available. If it is, don’t try to hold him alone; trade for an objective or bring more allies.

Udyr.watch: Watch out for the stun on Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s first attack right after he activates it. As he charges in, time Garen W Courage to absorb it with its shield and tenacity. Save Garen Q Decisive Strike to cleanse the slow from Udyr R Wingborne Storm. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on your max health, so don’t face him for long.
Udyr.build: Build armor first against Udyr’s main damage. If healing from Udyr W Iron Mantle shuts down your trades, buy Executioner’s Calling early and upgrade to Mortal Reminder sooner. If you’re struggling with the slow from Udyr R Wingborne Storm, choose Boots of Swiftness; if magic damage and stuns are a bigger threat, choose Mercury’s Treads.
Udyr.fight: Go in after Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield wears off and don’t give him time to heal. After you absorb one stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede, use the window when he can’t immediately stun the same target again to counterattack. When you close in, use Garen Q Decisive Strike’s movement speed and silence to stop his counterattack, then use Garen E Judgment.
Udyr.laning: Udyr starts in the jungle and appears for ganks, so ward key paths and jungle entrances. Don’t push forward when Udyr is out of sight; let the wave push toward you. After taking damage, retreat to a place where you won’t be hit by a champion and heal with Garen P Perseverance.
Udyr.combo: Once Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield wears off and you can close the gap, attack in this order: Garen Q Decisive Strike → empowered basic attack to silence → Garen E Judgment. If Udyr is already on you, use Garen E Judgment first and save Garen Q Decisive Strike to activate when you counterattack; after the spin ends, land the empowered basic attack. To finish him, wear down his health with Garen E Judgment, then use Garen R Demacian Justice. If he looks ready to flee, end the spin early and use it right away.
Udyr.phase: Early on, survive while watching for Udyr’s engages, and last-hit to build Garen W Courage’s armor and magic resistance stacks. If Garen survives the early game, this matchup gets more favorable over time, and your power peaks in the mid game, so turn your lane advantage and split pushing into a lasting lead. In the late game, Garen E Judgment alone may not deal enough damage, so focus on using Garen R Demacian Justice on low-health opponents.
Udyr.teamfight: When your team engages, activate Garen W Courage as Udyr goes in, then reduce the enemy’s armor with Garen E Judgment. Instead of forcing a kill on Udyr first while he’s tanky from defensive items and Udyr W Iron Mantle, target a weaker enemy behind him, then finish Udyr with your numbers advantage. Use Garen R Demacian Justice on low-health enemies, and split push in a side lane if there’s no good angle to engage.

Urgot.watch: If Urgot E Disdain catches you, Garen has no mobility spell to escape, making it easy for Urgot to follow up with more attacks. If you are hit by Urgot R Fear Beyond Death, get completely out of Urgot’s range before your health reaches the execute threshold.
Urgot.build: Urgot’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Urgot P Echoing Flames scales with your maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone; add penetration against Urgot’s high armor. If the enemy team has a lot of slows, choose Boots of Swiftness over Berserker’s Greaves.
Urgot.fight: Staying near Urgot for too long lets Urgot P Echoing Flames damage add up, so usually stay outside its short range. After Urgot E Disdain is down, close in with Garen Q Decisive Strike to silence him, then take a short trade with Garen E Judgment. As Urgot E Disdain comes at you, time Garen W Courage to gain its shield and tenacity.
Urgot.laning: Avoid direct fights early and let the wave come to you while farming last hits. Look to trade only when Urgot steps forward to last-hit a minion or just after he uses Urgot E Disdain. After trading, retreat out of range and recover with Garen P Perseverance; ward if the wave is pushed.
Urgot.combo: When Urgot E Disdain is down and you can engage, use Garen Q Decisive Strike → empowered attack to silence → Garen E Judgment. If you are already in range, use Garen E Judgment first and save Garen Q Decisive Strike to silence him with an empowered attack after the spin. To finish him, lower his health with Garen E Judgment, then use Garen R Demacian Justice. If Urgot tries to escape, end Garen E Judgment early and use Garen R Demacian Justice.
Urgot.escape: The moment Urgot’s mobility tool, Urgot E Disdain, is down is your window to go in. If Urgot Q Corrosive Charge slows you, cleanse it with Garen Q Decisive Strike, then decide whether to engage.
Urgot.phase: Urgot is difficult to face head-on in the early melee lane, so farm and hold on. Midgame is when Garen is strongest, so build a lane advantage and secure it with split pushing. The matchup gradually favors Garen after the early game, but Garen E Judgment alone may not be enough late, so look for an opening to use Garen R Demacian Justice on a low-health enemy.
Urgot.teamfight: If your team starts a fight, watch the path of Urgot E Disdain and, as he comes in, activate Garen W Courage to absorb it before engaging. Shred armor with Garen E Judgment and use Garen R Demacian Justice on a low-health enemy. If a head-on engage is difficult, look for an angle from the flank or out of vision; if there is no teamfight opening, split push in a side lane.

Volibear.watch: Volibear Q Thundering Smash stuns with an empowered basic attack after closing in, so run down the clock outside his attack range and activate Garen W Courage just before he hits you. If you see the mark from Volibear E Sky Splitter, move to the side to avoid its damage and slow. Don’t stay under a turret at low health while Volibear R Stormbringer is available.
Volibear.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Volibear Q Thundering Smash, W Frenzied Maul, and R Stormbringer. If the healing from Volibear W Frenzied Maul is a problem, buy Mortal Reminder earlier; if you need healing reduction sooner, start with Executioner’s Calling. Choose Boots of Swiftness if the enemy team has a lot of slows.
Volibear.fight: Avoid fighting if Volibear has built up attack speed from P The Relentless Storm by hitting minions; engage after the stacks fall off. Volibear can heal with W Frenzied Maul, so don’t fight for long if you can’t finish him decisively—back away. To engage, close in with the movement speed from Garen Q Decisive Strike, silence him, then deal damage with Garen E Judgment.
Volibear.laning: Let the wave come to you and ward; take short trades when Volibear steps up to last-hit. If Garen E Judgment pushes the wave, retreat into a brush and wait for Garen P Perseverance to heal you. Last-hit minions to build Garen W Courage’s armor and magic resistance as well.
Volibear.combo: If you can get into range first, use Garen Q Decisive Strike → empowered attack to silence → Garen E Judgment. If you are already in range, use Garen E Judgment first and save Garen Q Decisive Strike to use against the enemy’s counterattack. To finish him, lower his health with Garen E Judgment, then use Garen R Demacian Justice; if Volibear tries to escape, end E early and use R.
Volibear.escape: Wait outside attack range for the stun from Volibear Q Thundering Smash, then look to engage. Volibear can use both Q Thundering Smash and R Stormbringer for mobility, so don’t go deep just because Q is down; look for an opening before R comes back up. If Volibear E Sky Splitter slows you, cleanse it with Garen Q Decisive Strike and manage the distance.
Volibear.phase: Avoid forcing fights early and hold on with healing from Garen P Perseverance. Garen grows stronger as the game goes on, making the matchup more favorable over time; in midgame, secure an advantage with lane pressure and split pushing. Garen E Judgment alone may not be enough late, so use Garen R Demacian Justice on a low-health enemy.
Volibear.teamfight: If Volibear has stacks of P The Relentless Storm, don’t fight him right away; engage after they fall off. If your team starts a fight, activate Garen W Courage as the enemy attacks and engage, shred armor with Garen E Judgment, then use Garen R Demacian Justice on a low-health enemy. If there is no opening to engage, use Garen P Perseverance’s healing to hold an enemy in a side lane.

Yone.watch: Yone Q Mortal Steel can dash in and knock you up when its stacks are ready, so if Yone keeps using Q on minions, stay back until the stacks disappear. If Yone engages with E Soul Unbound and follows with R Fate Sealed, Garen has no mobility spell to escape easily; activate Garen W Courage as the abilities come in to absorb them with its shield and tenacity.
Yone.build: Prioritize attack speed and critical strike chance to increase Garen E Judgment’s damage. Yone deals both physical and magic damage, so build both armor and magic resistance instead of focusing on one type of resistance. Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Yone.fight: When Yone Q Mortal Steel’s stacks are gone, if he steps up to last-hit, close in with Garen Q Decisive Strike, silence him with the empowered attack, and trade with Garen E Judgment. If Yone engages first, spin with Garen E Judgment while saving Garen Q Decisive Strike, then silence him with an empowered attack as he tries to retaliate.
Yone.laning: Afterward, let the wave come to you and ward; when Yone Q Mortal Steel is stacked, wait outside its range. After trading, back off briefly to heal with Garen P Perseverance, and last-hit minions to build Garen W Courage’s armor and magic resistance as well.
Yone.combo: Before Yone engages, trade with Garen Q Decisive Strike → empowered attack to silence → Garen E Judgment. If Yone is already in range, use Garen E Judgment → Garen Q Decisive Strike, and silence him with your first attack after the spin. To finish him, lower his health with Garen Q Decisive Strike → empowered attack → Garen E Judgment, then use Garen R Demacian Justice. If Yone tries to escape, end E early and use R.
Yone.escape: Look to engage after Yone Q Mortal Steel’s stacks disappear and Yone E Soul Unbound is down. He can escape with his other mobility tool if only one is down, so check whether Yone R Fate Sealed is also unavailable.
Yone.phase: Garen E Judgment may not deal enough damage late, so look for an opportunity to use R on a low-health enemy.
Yone.teamfight: Space out from your allies so Yone W Spirit Cleave doesn’t hit several of you, and position with the fact that Yone R Fate Sealed moves behind the last champion in the formation in mind. If your team starts a fight, activate Garen W Courage as you are hit and engage; shred armor with Garen E Judgment, then use Garen R Demacian Justice on a low-health enemy. If a head-on engage is difficult, look for an angle from the flank or out of vision; if there is no opening, hold an enemy in a side lane.

Yorick.watch: Yorick E Mourning Mist slows, deals damage based on your maximum health, and marks you, so dodge the projectile first. When the Maiden of the Mist from Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles starts attacking you, create distance from Yorick himself.
Yorick.build: Build armor first against Yorick Q Last Rites and the Mist Walkers’ attacks. Yorick E Mourning Mist and R Eulogy of the Isles also deal damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone. Choose Boots of Swiftness if the enemy team has many slows, and buy a healing reduction item earlier if the healing from Yorick Q Last Rites is a problem.
Yorick.fight: After dodging Yorick E Mourning Mist, step forward and trade. Clear the Mist Walkers before fighting, and don’t start a fight where Yorick has stacked many graves. Once in range, use Garen Q Decisive Strike’s silence to stop his counterattack, then spin with Garen E Judgment.
Yorick.laning: When it is safe, push the wave so minions die under the enemy turret and Yorick can’t build graves on his side. Ward, since Garen is vulnerable to pressure when the wave is pushed. After trading, back off briefly to recover health with Garen P Perseverance.
Yorick.combo: If Yorick E Mourning Mist slows you, cleanse it with Garen Q Decisive Strike, then close in. Deal damage with Garen Q Decisive Strike → empowered attack to silence → Garen E Judgment. To finish him, lower his health with Garen E Judgment, then use Garen R Demacian Justice.
Yorick.escape: A missed Yorick E Mourning Mist that is on cooldown is your chance to step forward. You can try to engage if Yorick has also used Yorick W Dark Procession. Yorick has no ability to create distance on his own, so clear the Mist Walkers, get in range, and continue the fight.
Yorick.phase: Early on, hold on while watching out for Yorick’s graves and Mist Walkers. Garen grows stronger as the game goes on and peaks in midgame, so secure an advantage then with lane pressure and side-lane pressure. Garen E Judgment may not be enough late, so look for an opening to use Garen R Demacian Justice on a low-health enemy.
Yorick.teamfight: If your team starts a fight, activate Garen W Courage as the enemy ability hits and engage. Hold on while shredding the enemy’s armor with Garen E Judgment, then use Garen R Demacian Justice on a low-health enemy. If there is no opening to engage, absorb Yorick’s pressure in a side lane and look for a chance for your team to gain an advantage elsewhere.

Yasuo.watch: After Yasuo hits Yasuo Q Steel Tempest twice, the next tornado will knock you up. Watch for its sound and visual effect, then dodge sideways out of its path. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade uses minions to close the gap. If you get knocked up, Yasuo R Last Breath can follow, so keep your distance first. As the tornado comes in, use Garen W Courage for its shield and tenacity.
Yasuo.build: Build armor first to prepare for the physical damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath. Armor does not block the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. When choosing attack items, favor attack speed and critical strike, since Garen E Judgment does not apply on-hit effects.
Yasuo.fight: Break Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield before committing to a trade. Right after Yasuo throws a tornado and his knock-up stacks reset, he may step forward to last-hit a minion. Close in with Garen Q Decisive Strike, silence him, then use Garen E Judgment. If Yasuo engages first, fight back with Garen E Judgment and save Garen Q Decisive Strike until the moment you can counterattack.
Yasuo.laning: Keep the wave slightly pulled toward your side to limit the minions Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can use to dash in. If you need to push the wave, place a ward. Last-hit to build Garen W Courage’s growth stacks. After trading, move somewhere Yasuo cannot hit you and recover health with Garen P Perseverance.
Yasuo.combo: After breaking the shield and waiting out the tornado, trade in this order: Garen Q Decisive Strike → empowered basic attack to silence → Garen E Judgment. If Yasuo is already on you, switch the order to Garen E Judgment → Garen Q Decisive Strike, and silence him with your first basic attack after the spin ends. To execute, damage him with Garen E Judgment, then end the spin early if needed and use Garen R Demacian Justice.
Yasuo.escape: The moment after Yasuo throws Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s tornado is your chance to engage. Don’t chase just because Yasuo E Sweeping Blade is on cooldown; engage with crowd control before Yasuo R Last Breath is ready again. Garen has no skill to escape on his own, so if you miss that window, keep your distance again.
Yasuo.phase: Early on, watch for Yasuo’s repeated engages, pull the wave, and hold on. Garen gains an advantage as he builds growth stacks, and his power peaks in the mid game, so use lane priority and split pushing then to secure your lead. In the late game, Garen E Judgment alone may not be enough, so use Garen R Demacian Justice on opponents whose health is low.
Yasuo.teamfight: When your team starts a fight, use Garen W Courage and engage as Yasuo’s knock-up comes in. Hold the frontline with Garen E Judgment to reduce the opponent’s armor, then finish off low-health enemies with Garen R Demacian Justice. If a frontal engage is difficult, look for an angle from the flank or outside vision. If there’s no good teamfight angle, split push to keep one opponent occupied.
